limitations.note: The rewrite stopped green from continually reloading, but it also made red assert during reset and removed the original startup delay, whereas the reference fix changes only the green reload condition to `!green && p_green`.
The test required red to be on during reset and expected the rewrite's immediate countdown, so it could pass without detecting the reset and startup mismatch.
The search found two directly relevant traffic-light entries, but the agent opened neither before rewriting the module.
The entries the agent did read concerned a delayed zero flag and a Moore FSM transition; neither helped identify the green reload polarity error.
